info.title: AegisMem - the trust layer for agent memory
info.description: Production-grade persistent memory system for long-running LLM agents. Supports multi-store hybrid retrieval, versioned updates, contradiction detection, and higher-level reflection generation.

get.description: Readiness: every durable dependency answers. Kubernetes should gate traffic on this.

post.description: Ingest a single observation. Send ``Idempotency-Key`` to make retries safe.
Batch ingest. Every item is screened with its own declared source type.
Retrieve memories using hybrid semantic + symbolic search.

get.description: Get a single memory by ID.

schema.title: Response List Memories Api V1 Memories List Post

post.description: Smart update: creates, updates, merges, or supersedes based on LLM decision.
Generate higher-level reflections from stored memories.
Scan a memory for contradictions with existing memories.
Build a token-budgeted, cited context packet for a new agent, model or session.
Report which memories from a retrieval were used. Trains per-user ranking weights.

get.description: Inspect what the system has learned about ranking for this user.

delete.description: Discard learned ranking weights for this user (reverts to defaults).

post.description: Erase memories plus prior versions, derived memories and duplicates; return a signed receipt.
Check that a receipt was issued by this deployment and has not been altered.

get.description: Memories held back at ingest (low-trust, instruction-like). Never served until released.

post.description: Approve held content after review. It becomes retrievable, and its origin earns trust.
Reject held content. Its origin loses trust deployment-wide, and the content is erased with a receipt.

Correct a memory. ``wrong`` teaches distrust of its origin; ``outdated`` does not.
Memories derived from it are flagged as suspect and returned.
User or reviewer confirms a memory is correct; its origin earns trust.

get.description: Learned reliability of every source/origin, least trusted first.
How the write-risk model has adapted: reviewed holds, precision, live thresholds, top risk signals.

Aggregate statistics for one user's memories (tenant-scoped): counts by type and
status, importance, access totals and unresolved contradictions.

schema.title: Response List Keys Api V1 Admin Keys Get

get.description: Most recent mutating API calls for the caller's tenant (who did what, when).

schema.title: Response Audit Trail Api V1 Admin Audit Get

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 'wrong' (never true; penalises its origin), 'outdated' (changed; no penalty), 'malicious' (attack that slipped through; trains the risk model and erases it with derivatives)

corrected_text.title: Corrected Text
corrected_text.description: The right information, stored as the replacement

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Shown once. Store it in a secret manager.

used_memory_ids.title: Used Memory Ids
used_memory_ids.description: Memories from this retrieval the agent actually used; the rest count as unused

task.title: Task
task.description: What the receiving agent is about to do

since.title: Since
since.description: Only show changes/activity after this time
